d: What looked like a two-rider Honda runaway with JD Beach and Ashton Yates pulling clear early became a Beach victory, with Beach sweeping both Stock 1000 races at VIR. Jayson Uribe was second and Yates third.

JD Beach swept the VIR Stock 1000 weekend, winning a battle to the flag over Jayson Uribe by just .055 of a second after passing the OrangeCat BMW on the final lap. Ashton Yates completed the podium in third.

Alessandro Di Mario clinched the 2025 Twins Cup Championship on Saturday, with his dominant win also wrapping up the title. His Robem Engineering teammate Hank Vossberg was second by just .002 of a second over Avery Dreher.

Alessandro Di Mario won his seventh straight Twins Cup race on Sunday at VIR, stretching 4.5 seconds clear of a three-way battle for second. Dominic Doyle edged Hank Vossberg by .059 of a second for the runner-up spot.

st: 2023 Circuit of the Americas Baggers Race 1
d: Kyle Wyman took his sixth win of the season from the front, edging Hayden Gillim by 2.1 seconds to take a two-point championship lead. James Rispoli was third with Travis Wyman crashing out of second late in the race.

st: 2023 Circuit of the Americas Baggers Race 2
d: James Rispoli won Race 2 after Travis Wyman crashed out of second on the final lap, handing Rispoli victory. Hayden Gillim was second with rookie Kyle Ohnsorg earning his first career Baggers podium in third.
The championship heads to Mid-Ohio Sports Car Course during the high-energy AMA Vintage Motorcycle Days celebration.

st: 2023 Barber Motorsports Junior Cup Race 1 Highlights
d: Highlights of Avery Dreher extending his perfect season start with a fourth straight win. Max Van was second for the third straight race with Hayden Bicknese completing the podium in third.

st: 2023 Barber Motorsports Junior Cup Race 2 Highlights
d: Highlights of Levi Badie becoming the first Belgian ever to win in MotoAmerica, beating Hayden Bicknese by just three milliseconds. Four-time winner Avery Dreher had to settle for third.
2024 Road Atlanta was opener for Medallia Superbike, Supersport, and Junior Cup.
